name: WikiQA: A Challenge Dataset for Open-Domain Question Answering
description: WikiQA is a publicly available set of question and sentence pairs designed for open-domain question answering and answer sentence selection. Curated by Microsoft Research, questions were sampled from real Bing search query logs and paired with candidate answer sentences extracted from relevant Wikipedia articles, where 1,473 sentence pairs contain verified answer content, establishing a baseline for information retrieval and answer extraction.
